crossRefs.note: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with…
He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild…

people.name: David

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziph
people.line: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul

translations.web: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
translations.bsb: So Saul, accompanied by three thousand chosen men of Israel, went down to the Wilderness of Ziph to search for David there.
